description.zh: 致敬 Chrome 断网页的无限跑酷：跳过仙人掌、低头躲翼龙，速度越跑越快，昼夜还会交替。没有网也能玩。
description.en: A tribute to the Chrome offline runner: leap cacti, duck under pterodactyls, speed up endlessly and watch day turn to night.

controls.zh: 空格 / ↑ / 点击跳跃（长按跳更高），↓ 下蹲，Esc / P 暂停；触屏用「跳」「蹲」按钮
controls.en: Space / Up / tap to jump (hold for height), Down to duck, Esc / P to pause; on-screen Jump / Duck buttons on touch devices
